subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Segmentar palavras em sílabas e remover e substituir sílabas iniciais, mediais ou finais para criar novas palavras.

components.description_pt: Segmentar palavras faladas em sílabas individuais
components.description_en: Segment spoken words into individual syllables
components.cc_component_description: Segment spoken words into individual syllables

components.description_pt: Remover sílabas iniciais, mediais ou finais de palavra para formar nova palavra
components.description_en: Remove initial, medial, or final syllables from a word to form a new word
components.cc_component_description: Isolate and pronounce initial, medial, and final phonemes in spoken words

components.description_pt: Substituir sílabas em posições iniciais, mediais ou finais para produzir novas palavras
components.description_en: Substitute syllables in initial, medial, or final positions to produce new words
components.cc_component_description: Substitute individual phonemes in spoken words to produce new words

cc_matches.description: Count, pronounce, blend, and segment syllables in spoken words.
Demonstrate understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes).
